summary: This bill amends the Fair Labor Standards Act to require executive, administrative, and professional employees to earn at least $45,000 (rising to $55,000 in 2027, $65,000 in 2028, $75,000 in 2029, and the 55th percentile of national full-time salaried earnings thereafter) to qualify for overtime exemptions, while limiting nonexempt duties to no more than 20 percent of their time.
